leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply the Capacitor CLI to initialize a new Capacitor project within an existing Ionic Angular application.
Implement platform-specific builds by adding iOS and Android platforms using Capacitor commands.
Utilize the capacitor.config.ts file to configure application metadata including app name and bundle identifier.
Execute build commands to generate web assets for the Ionic Angular application.
Use the Capacitor sync command to copy web assets and update native project configurations.
Access native platform projects by opening them in their respective IDEs (Xcode for iOS, Android Studio for Android).
Construct production-ready application bundles by building native projects through platform-specific tools.
Modify capacitor.config.ts settings to customize build outputs and platform-specific configurations.
Invoke the Capacitor copy command to transfer updated web assets to native project directories.
Control the build pipeline sequence by executing commands in the correct order: build → sync → open → run.
Define environment-specific configurations to manage different build settings for development and production.
Implement live reload capabilities by configuring the Capacitor development server for testing on devices.
